assessments.summary: Conventional borax Na2B4O7·10H2O and the structural formula Na2[B4O5(OH)4]·8H2O have the same total Na2B4H20O17 composition. Gainsford et al. 2008 DOI10.1107/S1600536808010441 directly identifies this borax structure; supplier CAS1303-96-4/MW381.37 and CHEBI:38888 formula 8H2O.H4B4O9.2Na/MW381.371 corroborate it. The official octahydrate label counts eight free waters after hydroxylation; it does not assert conventional Na2B4O7·8H2O. This exact identity therefore does not collapse different hydrates. Current MANUAL_CURATION produces ManualMappingCuration and 0.9, accurately replacing an unsupported lexical establishing-method claim. The structural adjudication and original evidence/history are preserved, including explicit LLM authorship.
